items.contract: Review direct and ripple impact, inspect exact changes, explicitly accept, atomically advance the complete verified bundle, clear transient state, and use it as the next repair parent.
items.actorBoundary: Real Chrome over HTTP/PostgreSQL and packaged School Kernel
items.claim: The production actor journey reviews the server-authored proposal and keyboard-confirms exact atomic acceptance into a reusable baseline.

evidence.observation: Real Chrome creates the packaged repair, asserts six-category/unique/direct/ripple and old/proposed text, activates confirmation and acceptance with Space, then observes the current accepted timetable; PostgreSQL has ACCEPTED_BASELINE and no proposal/draft.

Assertions cross-check every proposal identity and regenerated review, compare accepted definition/result to the proposal after POST accept, prove proposal/draft absence, and compile the next repair from the new parent without the old attempt pin.

negativeObligations: No unconfirmed action advances the baseline
No partial bundle is current
Proposal and draft do not survive successful acceptance

items.contract: A lesson in direct effects and multiple kernel categories appears in each explanation but once in the unique total.
items.claim: Overlap is preserved in category membership while unique counting uses the lesson-ID union.

evidence.observation: l1 is asserted in teacherChanges and periodMoves and as a direct effect; three category entries across l1/l2 produce exactly two changed lessons.

negativeObligations: Overlap does not duplicate the unique total
Kernel category membership is not collapsed

items.contract: Empty categories and groupings show zero rather than disappearing.

evidence.observation: The unit test asserts all six category IDs including three empty arrays; Chrome asserts visible Additions 0 and Cancellations 0.

negativeObligations: Empty normative categories are not omitted

items.contract: An unchanged lesson is visibly quiet, remains accepted, and is excluded from change totals.
items.claim: The review offers unchanged accepted lessons separately without changing the 100-lesson total.

evidence.observation: Chrome first observes Unique changed lessons 100, opens an unchanged lesson, and sees the explicit not-included-in-change-totals label plus accepted assignment detail.

negativeObligations: Unchanged lesson is not added to change totals
Unchanged lesson is not labeled proposed

items.contract: Discard removes only the proposal and retains the accepted baseline and repair draft unchanged.
items.claim: DELETE proposal returns REPAIR_DRAFT with exact retained baseline/draft and no proposal.

evidence.observation: The test deep-copies baseline and draft, issues DELETE, compares both values, asserts REPAIR_DRAFT, and asserts proposal absence.

negativeObligations: Accepted baseline is not mutated
Repair draft is not mutated

items.contract: Revise intent invalidates the proposal immediately and returns to the retained repair draft.

items.claim: Revise intent invokes the proposal-only deletion transition and exposes the retained editable draft.

evidence.observation: The distinct revise button calls DELETE /api/proposal; the exercised production route removes proposal and returns exact REPAIR_DRAFT content.

negativeObligations: Proposal cannot remain eligible after revision choice
Accepted baseline is not mutated

items.contract: Any stale accepted, definition, intent, result, timetable, execution, or review identity invalidates the proposal without accepted mutation.
items.actorBoundary: Acceptance identity guard over real PostgreSQL
items.claim: Every persisted identity class is independently corrupted and refused as STALE_PROPOSAL while proposal eligibility is removed.

evidence.observation: Twelve corruptions cover source, accepted, successor, intent, proposed, run, limit, termination, elapsed, counts, result, and review; each returns 409, exact accepted equality, REPAIR_DRAFT, and absent proposal.

negativeObligations: Stale proposal does not become current
Prior accepted baseline is not mutated
Invalid proposal does not remain eligible

items.contract: Storage or reference-advance failure keeps the prior accepted bundle and unchanged proposal retryable.
items.claim: The acceptance transaction rolls back document and version and a later explicit retry succeeds.

evidence.observation: A trigger aborts the ACCEPTED_BASELINE update; HTTP returns safe 503, lifecycle remains REPAIR_PROPOSAL, exact document/version compare equal, and retry after removing the trigger returns 200.

negativeObligations: Current reference never points at partial storage
Proposal is not removed on storage failure
Version does not advance on rollback

items.contract: Headline counts unique lessons and cross-group totals are not summed as disjoint.

negativeObligations: Category totals are not substituted for the unique total
Cross-group counts are not summed
